nodes.description: Governance address; controls every onlyGov privileged setter and, in rebase(), the privileged alternative to tx.origin.
Pending governance address set by gov and consumed by _acceptGov().
Boolean gating flag that enables rebase windows; set once by activate_rebasing().
Timestamp of the last executed rebase; written before external interactions in rebase().
Monotonic rebase cycle counter incremented on every rebase.
Precomputed maximum slippage factor used by uniswapMaxSlippage().
Fractional distance from targetRate within which no supply change occurs.
Dampening divisor applied to the computed index delta.
Peg target exchange rate (1e18) used by computeOffPegPerc and withinDeviationThreshold.
External price oracle contract address; gov-settable, read for reserve token price.
Address receiving a percentage of reserve tokens acquired during rebase.
Percentage of treasury reserve tokens routed to public_goods.
Gov-managed list of enabled downstream calls executed in afterRebase().
YUAN<>Reserve Uniswap pair; the only address allowed to call uniswapV2Call().
List of Uniswap pairs synced in afterRebase().
List of Balancer pairs gulped in afterRebase().
Immutable reserve token whose oracle price defines the exchange rate.
YUAN token contract address used for mint/transferFrom/rebase calls.
Treasury/Liquidity/Lending reserve addresses (mutable).
Per-reserve mint percentages of each rebase, bounded by MAX_MINT_PERC_PARAM.
Last TWAP update timestamp (uint32); updated in init_twap() and getTWAP().
Last cumulative price snapshot used for TWAP differencing.
Timestamp of TWAP initialization; gates rebase activation by rebaseDelay.
Minimum seconds between rebases; also the modulo period for window math.
Offset into the interval at which the rebase window opens.
Length of the rebase window in seconds.
True when YUAN is token0 of the pair; selects reserve/amount branches.
Public rebase entrypoint; checks msg.sender == tx.origin || msg.sender == gov, verifies the time window, updates timestamp/epoch, and triggers afterRebase.
Uniswap flash-swap callback; mints/transfers YUAN and pushes reserve tokens out to treasury/public goods.
Internal helper computing swap sizes and initiating pair.swap against the Uniswap pair.
Post-rebase routine: syncs pairs, gulps Balancer pools, mints to reserves and executes gov-registered external calls.
Computes a moving-average Uniswap price using cumulative price deltas over elapsed time.
Multiplies the TWAP by the oracle reserve-token price to obtain the exchange rate.
Assembly low-level call() wrapper used to invoke gov-registered downstream transactions.
Validates rebasingActive and that block.timestamp modulo interval falls inside the rebase window.
Anyone-callable one-way activator requiring the delay elapsed and a positive oracle price.
Initializes TWAP state once, storing cumulative price and timestamp.
Transfers governance to pendingGov; guarded only by msg.sender == pendingGov.
onlyGov setter for pendingGov.
onlyGov setter for maxSlippageFactor bounded by MAX_SLIPPAGE_PARAM.

onlyGov setter for the interval/offset/length timing parameters.

onlyGov appender of downstream transactions executed during afterRebase().
onlyGov toggle for a stored transaction's enabled flag.
onlyGov remover of a stored transaction.
onlyGov token rescue using SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
Sets timings, sorts tokens, derives the pair, and assigns gov = msg.sender.
Computes the absolute percentage deviation from targetRate and its sign.
Returns whether the rate is within the threshold of targetRate.
Constant-product output calculator with 0.3% fee.
Derives the maximum sellable amount from pool reserves and off-peg percentage.
View variant of the TWAP computation.
View variant combining the current TWAP and oracle price.
Caller-controlled address; gates privileged setters, _acceptGov, and the rebase entrypoint.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for rebase window checks and TWAP elapsed-time math.
Transaction origin accepted as an alternative authorization in rebase().
Assembly call() with forwarded gas to a gov-registered destination and arbitrary calldata.
Uniswap pair.swap() that transfers tokens and synchronously invokes the uniswapV2Call callback.
ERC20 transfer performed through a low-level call that may execute token fallback logic.
Privileged YUAN minting into the pair or reserve contracts.
External call into the YUAN token to apply the scaling-factor change.
Token pull from the treasury reserve into the Uniswap pair.
External sync() on every registered Uniswap pair.
External Balancer gulp() call on every registered pool.
External oracle call whose return value directly determines the exchange rate.
Callback initiator address; must equal address(this).
Amount of token0 sent out by the pair.
Amount of token1 sent out by the pair.
Attacker-reachable calldata decoded into UniVars.
Treasury mint amount available for the reserve purchase.
Off-peg percentage driving the slippage limit.
Per-reserve mint amounts produced by rebase().
Off-peg percentage forwarded to the reserve purchase.
token0 reserve balance.
token1 reserve balance.

Input amount of the sold asset.
Reserve of the sold asset.
Reserve of the purchased asset.

Gov-registered calldata for the low-level call.
Token contract to rescue.
Recipient of the rescued tokens.

Calldata stored in a new downstream transaction.
Index of the reserve whose percentage is updated.
New mint percentage for the reserve.
New slippage factor value.
Dampened supply change fraction, reduced by minting.
TWAP-derived exchange rate for this rebase.
Cumulative price snapshot captured at initialization.
Current block timestamp captured at initialization.

edges.reason: rebase() authorizes callers via msg.sender == tx.origin || msg.sender == gov.
rebase() accepts tx.origin as the primary authorization path for any EOA.
_acceptGov() requires msg.sender == pendingGov.
onlyGov modifier compares msg.sender against gov.
onlyGov modifier on setMaxSlippageFactor.
onlyGov modifier on setRebaseMintPerc.
onlyGov modifier on setReserveContract.
onlyGov modifier on setDeviationThreshold.
onlyGov modifier on setRebaseLag.
onlyGov modifier on setTargetRate.
onlyGov modifier on setPriceOracle.
onlyGov modifier on setRebaseTimingParameters.
onlyGov modifier on addSyncPairs.
onlyGov modifier on addTransaction.
onlyGov modifier on setTransactionEnabled.
onlyGov modifier on removeTransaction.
onlyGov modifier on rescueTokens.
Constructor assigns gov = msg.sender, seeding the entire privilege system.
gov is the alternative authorization value compared in rebase().
_acceptGov() reads gov and overwrites it with pendingGov.
pendingGov is the sole authorization source for _acceptGov().
Rebase window is computed from now modulo the interval, a timestamp dependency.
rebase() uses now for interval checks and timestamp snapping.
init_twap() records the block timestamp for the TWAP baseline.
getTWAP() derives elapsed time from the current block timestamp.
getCurrentTWAP() derives elapsed time from the current block timestamp.
activate_rebasing() compares now against timeOfTWAPInit + rebaseDelay.
rebase() writes the snapped lastRebaseTimestampSec before external calls.
rebase() increments the epoch counter.
rebase() reads rebaseMintPercs to size the treasury mint.
rebase() consumes the exchange rate returned by getExchangeRate().
rebase() invokes afterRebase() once the scaling factor has been applied.
rebase() calls _inRebaseWindow() which can revert outside the window.
rebase() uses computeOffPegPerc() output as the index delta input.
indexDelta is scaled by 1/BASE and divided by rebaseLag using SafeMath.
Exchange rate is cached locally for deviation computation.
mintAmounts are derived from currSupply * indexDelta * perc / BASE chains.
afterRebase() routes the treasury mint amount into buyReserveAndTransfer().
afterRebase() iterates uniSyncPairs to sync each pair.
afterRebase() iterates balGulpPairs to gulp each pool.
afterRebase() executes gov-registered arbitrary external calls after state updates.
afterRebase() reads the transactions array to drive downstream calls.
afterRebase() invokes UniswapPair.sync() on registered pairs.
afterRebase() invokes BAL.gulp() on registered Balancer pools.
afterRebase() mints YUAN to the liquidity and lending reserves.
buyReserveAndTransfer() reads the Uniswap pair address and its reserves.
buyReserveAndTransfer() uses getAmountOut() to size the swap output.
buyReserveAndTransfer() uses uniswapMaxSlippage() to cap the sell size.
buyReserveAndTransfer() initiates pair.swap(), handing control to the pair and back into the callback.
pair.swap() synchronously re-enters this contract through uniswapV2Call().
uniswapV2Call() mints YUAN to the pair or to reserves based on decoded params.
uniswapV2Call() pulls YUAN from the treasury reserve via transferFrom.
uniswapV2Call() forwards reserve tokens using SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
uniswapV2Call() credits the treasury reserve contract address.
uniswapV2Call() may send a share of reserve tokens to public_goods.
uniswapV2Call() scales the outflow by public_goods_perc.
uniswapV2Call() branches on isToken0 to choose amount0 or amount1.
uniswapV2Call() requires msg.sender == uniswap_pair as its only caller check.
uniswapV2Call() decodes attacker-reachable data into the uniVars struct.
getExchangeRate() trusts the external oracle price of reserveToken.
getExchangeRate() composes getTWAP() with the oracle price.
getTWAP() reads and updates blockTimestampLast.
getTWAP() reads and updates priceCumulativeLast.
getTWAP() samples cumulative prices from the Uniswap pair.
getTWAP() selects which cumulative price to read based on isToken0.
timeElapsed uses intentional uint32 wraparound; underestimates the period.
init_twap() writes timeOfTWAPInit, which gates the rebase delay.
init_twap() seeds blockTimestampLast.
init_twap() seeds priceCumulativeLast.
init_twap() stores the sampled cumulative price locally before writing state.
init_twap() stores the sampled timestamp locally before writing state.
activate_rebasing() flips rebasingActive to true.
activate_rebasing() requires a positive external oracle price.
activate_rebasing() enforces now >= timeOfTWAPInit + rebaseDelay.
_inRebaseWindow() requires rebasingActive.
_inRebaseWindow() takes now modulo minRebaseTimeIntervalSec.
_inRebaseWindow() bounds the window start with rebaseWindowOffsetSec.
_inRebaseWindow() bounds the window end with rebaseWindowLengthSec.
setMaxSlippageFactor() updates maxSlippageFactor under MAX_SLIPPAGE_PARAM.
setRebaseMintPerc() writes a slot of rebaseMintPercs and validates the total.
setReserveContract() replaces one reserve contract address.
_setPendingGov() writes pendingGov.
setDeviationThreshold() writes deviationThreshold.
setRebaseLag() writes rebaseLag.
setTargetRate() writes targetRate.
setPriceOracle() writes priceOracle.
setRebaseTimingParameters() writes minRebaseTimeIntervalSec.
setRebaseTimingParameters() writes rebaseWindowOffsetSec.
setRebaseTimingParameters() writes rebaseWindowLengthSec.
addSyncPairs() appends to uniSyncPairs.
addSyncPairs() appends to balGulpPairs.
addTransaction() pushes a new enabled Transaction.
setTransactionEnabled() toggles a stored transaction flag.
removeTransaction() shrinks the transactions array.
rescueTokens() transfers arbitrary tokens with SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
externalCall() forwards ~all remaining gas to an arbitrary destination via assembly call().
The call target is the gov-supplied destination parameter.
The calldata payload is the gov-supplied data parameter.
Constructor sets the initial governor.
Constructor computes and stores the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor fixes the reserve token address.
Constructor fixes the YUAN token address.
computeOffPegPerc() compares the rate against targetRate.
withinDeviationThreshold() scales targetRate by deviationThreshold.
withinDeviationThreshold() measures absolute distance from targetRate.
rebase() calls into the YUAN token to apply the scaling factor.
The sender parameter is checked against address(this) to validate the callback origin.
amount0 drives the reserve token payout when YUAN is not token0.
amount1 drives the reserve token payout when YUAN is token0.
data is abi.decoded into UniVars and governs all mint/transfer amounts.
mintAmount sets the swap size in the fully-capable branch.
offPegPerc feeds the slippage cap computation.
uniVars is built and ABI-encoded into the pair.swap calldata.
mintAmounts decide whether the reserve purchase and reserve mints run.
offPegPerc is forwarded to buyReserveAndTransfer().
token0 reserve balance bounds the sell size.
token1 reserve balance bounds the sell size.
offPegPerc selects between the capped and heuristic slippage branches.
amountIn is fee-adjusted inside the constant-product formula.
reserveIn forms the denominator of the pricing formula.
reserveOut forms the numerator of the pricing formula.
amountOut = amountInWithFee * reserveOut / (reserveIn * 1000 + amountInWithFee); rounding favors the pool.
The token parameter selects the rescued ERC20.
The to parameter is the rescue recipient.
The amount parameter is the rescued quantity.
The destination parameter is stored for later external execution.
The data parameter is stored as raw calldata for later execution.
The reserve index parameter selects the slot to update.
The percentage parameter is validated against MAX_MINT_PERC_PARAM.
The new factor parameter must be below MAX_SLIPPAGE_PARAM.

normalization_plan.reason: Callback origin parameter is only used for the msg.sender/address(this) authorization check inside uniswapV2Call().
Transient swap output amount consumed only by the SafeERC20.safeTransfer branch of uniswapV2Call().
Transient swap output amount consumed only by the SafeERC20.safeTransfer branch of uniswapV2Call().
Attacker-reachable calldata is decoded solely within uniswapV2Call() to size mints and transfers.
Treasury mint amount is only meaningful inside the buyReserveAndTransfer swap-sizing logic.
Off-peg percentage is only consumed by the slippage computation triggered from buyReserveAndTransfer().
Per-reserve mint amounts are only dispatched inside afterRebase().
Off-peg percentage is threaded through afterRebase() into the reserve purchase.
token0 reserve value is a local input to the slippage bound arithmetic.
token1 reserve value is a local input to the slippage bound arithmetic.
Off-peg percentage only selects the branch inside uniswapMaxSlippage().
Input amount is a pure-math parameter of the constant-product helper.
Input reserve is a pure-math parameter of the constant-product helper.
Output reserve is a pure-math parameter of the constant-product helper.
Returned local computed by the constant-product formula; normalizes into the helper.
Destination parameter is the target of the unsafe assembly call() and normalizes into that operation.
Calldata parameter is the payload of the unsafe assembly call() and normalizes into that operation.
Token parameter is only used to build the SafeERC20 transfer call.
Recipient parameter is only used to build the SafeERC20 transfer call.
Amount parameter is only used to build the SafeERC20 transfer call.
Destination is stored verbatim into the transactions array by addTransaction().
Calldata is stored verbatim into the transactions array by addTransaction().
Index parameter only selects the rebaseMintPercs slot within the setter.
Percentage parameter is only validated and stored by the setter.
New factor parameter is only validated and stored by the setter.
Locally computed dampened delta that drives the scaling factor and mint math in rebase().
Locally cached exchange rate used only to derive the off-peg percentage.
Local per-reserve mint array produced in rebase() and forwarded to afterRebase().
Sampled cumulative price is a local that is immediately written to storage by init_twap().
Sampled timestamp is a local that is immediately written to storage by init_twap().
Wrapping elapsed-time local used only inside the TWAP averaging arithmetic.
Decoded struct local whose fields are consumed only inside the callback.
Encoded struct local built only to be passed into pair.swap.
